notes: RektJackpotHook serves the REKTD/native ETH pool. RektdToken has no constructor arguments. The hook constructor takes only the PoolManager and owner; $owner is also the initial creatorFeeRecipient. beforeInitialize requires a PoolManager caller, native ETH as currency0 and no previously registered pool; it records currency1 as the launch token. It accepts initialization from any sender, including the launch factory, and does not restrict fee or tick spacing, so it accepts the declared 12500 LP fee and spacing 60. There are no token or factory constructor parameters. All enabled callbacks require the PoolManager. The 1% ETH hook fee is additional to the 1.25% LP fee: beforeSwap returns the fee delta when ETH is specified, afterSwap returns it when REKTD is specified, and afterSwap mints ERC-6909 ETH claims to the hook. No ETH is transferred during swaps. Half of each hook fee, rounded down, accrues to pendingCreatorFees and the remainder to jackpotPool. Any router may swap or quote. A 32-byte hookData address identifies the buyer; other lengths use tx.origin. Zero, burn-address and malformed 32-byte buyers still pay fees but cannot become leader. A qualifying buy meets max(0.0005 ETH, ceil(5% of jackpotPool)) using the jackpot before this swap's fee. It starts a 600-second round or extends it by 120 seconds, capped at 600 seconds from the current block time. Expired rounds allocate 60% of the jackpot to the leader, 20% to the burn address and the remainder to rollover. beforeSwap records expired-round payouts without transfers. Permissionless settleRound(), claimCreatorFees() and claimPayout(address) redeem claims through PoolManager.unlock; rejected ETH payouts remain claimable. The owner may change creatorFeeRecipient, which also redirects pending creator fees not yet claimed. No liquidity callbacks are enabled. initialPrice records the required one-to-one reference; the deployer derives the opening price from the separate launch policy's opening market cap and deployed token address.
